method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Juries Act 1957 (WA), the compilation published on legislation.wa.gov.au (mrdoc 48914, retrieved 7 September 2026; no compilation number given), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_48914.txt; no regulations used (no regulations under s 62 are deposited, so the s 58B allowances, expenses, fees and prescribed classes are inputs)

scope: From the seat of the person summonsed for jury service, for the WA cradle-to-grave lives: ss 4 (with Electoral Act 1907 ss 17AA, 17A, 17B as facts), 5 and Schedule 1 (as data), 31, 32D(2), 32E, 32I, 33(5), 33A and Schedule 2, 34E, 34F, 34G, 34H, 34I, 34J, 42, 55, 56, 56A, 56B, 56E, 58B. The officer's or court's satisfaction, reasonable excuse, undue hardship, and the Regulations' amounts and classes are inputs. Jury districts, lists and the jurors' book, choosing panels and pools, empanelling, challenges, verdicts, s 57 and the Jury Exemption Act 1965 (Cth) are out.
seat: the person summonsed for jury service
